auditor.actual_model_source: FALLBACK DISCLOSED: the run began on anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 and fell back to anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, then openai/gpt-6.1-sol, then deepseek/deepseek-flash after repeated provider quota failures. All three later models worked from the same evidence gathered in this session, and every byte-level check (hashes, ICU parse, plural renders, token and whitespace scans) is mechanical and model-independent. No model performed any translation.
auditor.independence_note: This session wrote no fr value and edited no source file. Every judgement is derived from the bytes on disk (en + context sidecars vs fr) and from the shipped fr catalogue outside these 21 namespaces; the earlier s3a/s3b receipts were used only as a checklist of findings to verify. The repo is untouched apart from this receipt.

verdict_reason: 318 keys read in full across 16 namespaces (140 in the eleven B2 namespaces, 178 in the five B1 namespaces whose bytes changed since the s3b receipt); the five batch A namespaces are carried at the s3b hashes (143 keys, not re-audited). ICU structure, CLDR fr categories (one/many/other), number skeletons including ::group-off, literal tokens, the vous register and U+202F typography hold in every audited value. One MAJOR: device_move.result.moved.second tells the reader to open the conversation « sur cet appareil » where the English says « on that device », contradicting the receipt line printed beside it. Six MINOR (glossary « répertoire » vs « dossier de travail »; « daemon » vs « service »; « stalled » as « bloqué » vs shipped « en attente »; the answered participle's gender against its own status family; two comma splices; a partitive « de » after a sum; one width flag) and six NIT. Every earlier s3b finding in a changed namespace is applied, and none of those edits introduced a defect.
